label: final copy step of length-3 sequences (t=5, outputting orig(2))
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase of length-3 sequences, at the last step (t=5), where the input is the echoed orig(1) and the model outputs orig(2) (so prev2_tok is <DEL>). On dev, (L==3)&(t==5) gets precision 0.95, recall 0.73, F1 0.83, and covers 92% of activation mass. Every top activation is this step. The missed activations are weak (the lowest quartile is only 19% covered): the previous step of L=3 sequences (t=4, outputting orig(1)), the recall_idx=2 step of L=4 sequences (t=6), and a few scattered late copy steps in L=9 sequences. It never fires in the original phase or at the delimiter, and never on the first occurrence of a token. The exact token has only a weak effect on magnitude (out_tok lift ranges from about 2x to 3.5x).

issues: The missed activations (about 26% of active steps but only about 8% of activation mass) are spread across low-precision contexts. (L==4)&(t==6) has test precision 0.027 and (L==9)&(t==17) has 0.005, so neither forms a recoverable class. Adding either one lowers F1 (to 0.28 and 0.23).
The claim that it never fires on the first occurrence of a token adds little: the unit only fires in the copy phase, where every input is an echoed token that already appeared.

The claimed weak spots are confirmed: L=3, t=4 has precision 0.05 and makes up most of the lowest activation quartile. Profile shows 0 activations in the original phase and at the delimiter, and 92% of activation mass at t=5.
